paragraphs: 4 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Tuesday for 4 clubs across 3 levels, with Alejandro Garza producing the night's most notable performance.
Alejandro Garza drove in 1 run with a single in the eighth, on a 1-1 pitch from Trendan Parish.
Hill City Howlers fell to Charleston RiverDogs, 7-10.
Ryan Tayman also appeared for St. Lucie Mets at Single-A. He went 1-for-2, 1 RBI, 1 walk. He batted 4th and started at C. St. Lucie Mets fell to Lakeland Flying Tigers, 1-10.
Brooks Lee also appeared for Minnesota Twins. He went 1-for-3. He batted 7th and started at 3B. Minnesota Twins beat Atlanta Braves, 4-1.

Bryce Warrecker also appeared for Hudson Valley Renegades at High-A. He worked 1.1 innings, allowing 3 hits and 1 earned run, with 0 walks and 1 strikeout. He started at P. Hudson Valley Renegades beat Jersey Shore BlueClaws, 10-5.
title: Alejandro Garza highlights a busy Tuesday for former Mustangs
